caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a beige background and depicts an ornate iron railing or grille. The railing consists of four identical vertical panels, each with symmetrical, decorative scrollwork. Each panel features two main vertical bars with curled ends at the top and bottom, and a prominent central circular motif. This motif is created from intersecting curved lines and includes a star-like shape in the middle. Additional curvilinear elements branch outward from the central circle and repeat underneath and above, creating a diamond-like frame around each circle. The bottom of the railing pole is shown mounted on a narrow ledge represented with crosshatch shading. The design is contained within a single rectangular frame with rounded corners, and the drawing utilizes consistent line weight and parallel hatching to convey depth and dimension.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
